verdict.rationale: The Gemini CLI repo documents first-party event-driven automation on GitHub: automated PR reviews, automated issue triage, and @gemini-cli mentions that trigger assistance. However, nothing shows users can define their own rules or hooks mapping arbitrary events to actions; non-interactive scripting is only a building block. missing for 10: user-definable event→action rules/hooks, documentation of how triggers are configured, coverage of events beyond GitHub PRs/issues, independent corroboration of the triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions
Issue Triage: Automated labeling and prioritization of GitHub issues based on content analysis
Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
